summary: INV-04 Resend and revoke invitation: implemented POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations/:invitationId/resend and POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations/:invitationId/revoke. Workspace Owner can resend/revoke any invitation; Project Managers can resend/revoke member and viewer invitations only (manager target returns 403 FORBIDDEN). Resending rotates the cryptographic token with a fresh 32-byte secret and SHA-256 hash, refreshes expires_at to +7 days, transitions status back to pending, invalidates the prior token, and emits a new outbox event. Revoking sets status to revoked, preventing any subsequent acceptance. Both routes support idempotency key replay. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Outbox queue delivery worker is implemented in INV-02.
